rate_columns.code: required for single-table input, optional per-code input
rate_columns.limit_rate: fraction from explicit point-in-time evidence, e.g. rate supplied by caller; no policy assumption
rate_columns.limit_exempt: optional bool; true explicitly asserts no lower price limit on that day
rate_columns.exempt: preferred explicit no-limit bool; limit_exempt accepted as alias
rate_columns.evidence: preferred source/version string; evidence_id accepted as alias

missing_evidence: UNKNOWN, not False. Any confirmed pair rejects; if no confirmed pair but an unresolved possible pair is in rolling20, emit unresolved candidate separately. Missing rate code/day always audited even when logic can prove no pair. Missing preclose reference on a valid feature bar is explicit no-evidence.
calendar: May contain already-announced formal sessions beyond price cutoff. Signals after cutoff are not generated and next-session prices beyond cutoff are never used.
import: No filesystem reads/writes or scan on module import; source module loaded/hash-checked only on explicit call.
manifest_injected_rates: When config.limits is omitted, manifest.daily_limit_rates must reference a file bound by manifest.files; no original manifest is modified.
outputs: id and signal_id are code_signal-date, plus original cohort-compatible state fields; entry_raw_open only if strictly valid, next_raw_open is provider quote even for suspension.
